harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Established a file-integrity baseline for /etc on node1 using sha256sum + stat metadata (AIDE was unavailable — no outbound internet/DNS on this node), with a companion check script. Verified detection works, restored a clean baseline, then executed the mandatory single-node restart with boot-id proof and post-restart baseline persistence/health verification.
actions_performed: Confirmed CentOS Stream 10 on node1 and that aide is not installed
Attempted dnf install aide; found no outbound internet connectivity (DNS resolves but connections time out) so package install is not viable

Wrote /usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity-baseline.sh: generates sha256 hashes of all regular files under /etc plus stat metadata (type/mode/uid/gid/size/mtime) for every entry, stored in /var/lib/etc-integrity-baseline (mode 700, files 600)
Wrote /usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity-check.sh: recomputes current /etc state and diffs against the stored baseline, reporting added/removed paths and content changes
Ran the baseline generator (580 files hashed, 1545 metadata entries) and confirmed a clean check (no diff)
Created a test file under /etc, re-ran the check script, and confirmed it correctly reported the new file/dir and its sha256 as added — proving the mechanism detects change
Removed the test file and regenerated a clean baseline (580 files, no diff)
Captured pre-restart boot_id (d052eb57-...) and baseline state as healthy baseline evidence
Issued `shutdown -r now` backgrounded via nohup so the ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again; confirmed new boot_id (9306d659-...), proving an actual restart occurred

Post-restart: verified baseline files persisted on disk and ran the check script — only /etc and /etc/resolv.conf metadata (mtime) differed due to normal NetworkManager boot activity, with no content/sha256 changes, confirming the baseline and detection tooling remained intact and functional after restart

evidence.requirement: Establish integrity baseline for /etc on node1
evidence.summary: Created baseline dir, baseline-generation and check scripts, and ran the generator producing sha256.baseline (580 files) and metadata.baseline (1545 entries) for /etc

evidence.requirement: Baseline can identify later changes to /etc files
evidence.summary: Injected a test file under /etc; check script correctly flagged the new directory metadata change and the new file's sha256 as an addition

evidence.requirement: Baseline restored to clean state after detection test
evidence.summary: Removed test file, regenerated baseline (580 files), confirmed check reports zero diff
Captured boot_id d052eb57-c81d-4309-ae7f-bce362073ff9 and baseline.info showing 580/1545 clean baseline before restart
`shutdown -r now` issued backgrounded via nohup; command returned reboot_issued before the node dropped

evidence.requirement: Node restart proof via changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Connection timed out twice while node was down, then exec succeeded with new boot_id 9306d659-4a01-4fdf-a8ff-e814f7015292, differing from pre-restart d052eb57-...

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery/health of integrity baseline and /etc
evidence.summary: Baseline files intact after reboot; check script ran successfully and reported only expected non-content metadata changes (resolv.conf regenerated by NetworkManager, /etc dir mtime), no sha256/content drift, confirming both /etc and the integrity tooling survived the restart correctly
